'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Four soldiers and two [[militant]]s are killed during [[Shootout|gunfights]] between the [[Pakistan Army]] and the [[Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan]] in [[Mir Ali, Pakistan|Mir Ali]], [[North Waziristan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/31/four-soldiers-killed-in-raid-on-pakistan-taliban-hideout (Al Jazeera)]
*Six soldiers from [[Niger]] and [[Nigeria]] are killed and 16 others are wounded during a fight with [[Islamic State – West Africa Province|ISWAP]] militants in the [[Lake Chad]] region of [[Borno State]], Nigeria. Twenty-two militants are also killed and 17 more are captured. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/six-nigerian-niger-troops-killed-by-islamic-state-security-forces-say-2021-12-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Metro Manila]]
*****[[Metro Manila]] moves into Alert Level 3 from January 3 to 15 amid an increase in the number of [[COVID-19]] cases and the detection of local cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1534501/ncr-under-alert-level-3-from-jan-3-to-jan-15-palace (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
****The [[Philippines]] reports its first three locally transmitted cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant. [https://cnnphilippines.com/news/2021/12/31/Philippines-first-local-cases-of-Omicron.html (CNN Philippines)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Hong Kong]] reports its first potential community cluster of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]], which are also the first locally transmitted cases reported by the city since June. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-12-31/potential-omicron-cluster-clouds-hong-kong-s-virus-free-streak (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] extends fourth doses of the COVID-19 vaccine to elderly people in care facilities and begins administering fourth doses for vulnerable people, citing the high-risk  of infection. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/israel-extends-4th-covid-vaccine-elderly-care-facilities-2021-12-31/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
*****[[Florida]] reports 75,900 cases of [[COVID-19]], a new single-day record. [https://www.wftv.com/news/local/florida-breaks-single-day-covid-19-record-with-75900-cases/AYK7G3KVVRHMBLL6WUCJWKTMYY/?outputType=amp (WFTV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
*****[[New York (state)|New York]] reports a new record of 85,476 cases, with 22% of all tests being positive. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/01/01/world/omicron-covid-vaccine-tests (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Brunswick]]
*****[[List of premiers of New Brunswick|New Brunswick premier]] [[Blaine Higgs]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/new-brunswick/nb-covid-19-roundup-dec-31-1.6301325 (CBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[Paris]] begins to implement mandatory [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|outdoor mask wearing]] for people over the age of 11 years. This comes as [[France]] reports a substantial increase in new cases of the Omicron variant nationwide. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20211230-paris-mandates-wearing-masks-even-outdoors-starting-friday (France 24)]
****France reports a record 232,200 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is also the highest daily total recorded in any European nation since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1996106/world (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****[[Cyprus]] reports a record for the fifth consecutive day of 5,048 new cases of COVID-19, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 166,827. [https://in-cyprus.philenews.com/two-deaths-from-covid-and-another-new-record-number-of-new-cases-on-friday/ (In-Cyprus)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 40,560 new cases of COVID-19, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,170,293. [https://greekreporter.com/2021/12/31/new-covid-19-record-set-as-40560-cases-announced-in-greece/ (Greek Reporter)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 144,243 new cases of COVID-19. [https://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2021/12/31/covid-new-record-of-over-144000-new-cases_6216883c-990e-4064-a6c2-ff8ef9f4a526.html (ANSA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
****The [[Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency]] approves the use of [[Pfizer]]'s anti-viral oral drug [[Paxlovid]] for high-risk patients. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/paxlovid-covid-pill-pfizer-uk-b1984885.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
***[[New Zealand]] moves COVID-19 traffic light settings for [[Auckland]] from red to orange, allowing bars, restaurants and cafes that enforce the [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|vaccine pass]] requirement to remove crowd size limits and requirements to sit down, despite fears of community transmission of the Omicron variant. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/dec/31/new-zealand-eases-covid-crowd-rules-in-time-for-new-years-eve-despite-omicron-scare (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Niger]]
***[[Niger]] reports its first case of the Omicron variant in the capital [[Niamey]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/niger-sees-1st-case-of-omicron-coronavirus-variant-/2462403 (Anadolu Agency)]
